summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py: thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in the constructor and set/cleared in a try/finally inside the run entry point; the method checks not-running, then same-thread, then schedules a coroutine via run_coroutine_threadsafe that sets the active app and calls the existing invoke helper on a functools.partial-bound callable, and blocks once on the result. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests, all passing on the venv Python 3.9 (run with PYTHONPATH=src). Wider suite (excluding snapshot, cli, devtools): 614 passed, 68 failed. Based on the failures I checked, they come from async tests this venv cannot run and devtools missing aiohttp; I did not verify against a clean baseline. Nothing committed. The after-stop test calls from the main thread after run returns, which departs from the spec's "issued while running" rule.
